chunks: From the father, from Sa'd, from al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Tha'laba, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Men are of three kinds: a man by his wealth, a man by his status/prestige, and a man by his tongue, and he is the best of the three.

key_terms.أَفْضَل: The best, most superior, or most virtuous
key_terms.لِسَان: Tongue, referring to eloquence, speech, or knowledge

ai.seo_question: What are the three types of men according to Imam al-Sadiq and which is best?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) categorizes men into three types based on what defines their value or authority: wealth, social status (prestige), or eloquence/knowledge (tongue). He identifies the man defined by his tongue as the superior of the three.
